## Discussion & Limitations
- As the exact year and date are dropped the model can not learn a trend over the years, e.g. increasing number of trips in certain areas. To solve this, the model should either take these additional information into account in future or must be regulary retrained to ensure the most up to date values
- Static values for the POI are a limitation. They might already be included in the target variable but we decided to keep them, as they may help the model to correlate between similar census tracts/ community area
- Spatial Limitation for census tract: only has half of the data
- Census tract is missing in most of the records, therefore it gets filled by 0s which improve the prediction in this context
- Census tract might have changed
- Demand might not be accurate due to removing of records, especially for the census tracts
- Coordinates are centroids and not exact locations
